notice: These operations, content hashes, approval shadows, Executor-dispatch and verifier-stop provenance values, Attempt-owned interruption origins and recovery dispositions, abstract recovery-safety and Policy effect-quiescence witnesses, terminal source phases, cancellation correlation tokens, and post-cancel safe-convergence marker are design-time semantic labels. They are not the G2-03/G2-04/G2-05 Command, Event, Evidence, API, hash, identifier, or storage schema. Gate 5 must replace the abstract safety witnesses with concrete proof that all relevant effect-capable work stopped or never started and, for Recovery, that the governed workspace was reconciled.

statePreservingFacts.meaning: Changes the unapproved candidate content identity and optional Contract-owned maxAttempts while preserving lifecycle state. Waiting, frozen, and superseded versions are not editable.

Records intent to stop but cannot claim that stopping has completed. INTERRUPTED is eligible only for zero-Attempt Preflight abandonment or the already-related unknown stop flow; it cannot replace an Attempt-level INCONCLUSIVE judgment.
Records a deterministic, correctable diagnostic without creating an Attempt, Verdict, or Outcome.

Appends an immutable abstract proof identity after all prior effect-capable Executor or verifier work is proven stopped or never started and the governed workspace is reconciled. It preserves the interruption-time disposition and every lifecycle state; CANCEL_STOP_UNKNOWN is ineligible.
